endowment_summary: Karate from age 3, boxing from 11. Won four national high school tournaments. Won WBO world title in only his 5th professional fight. Suffered from Legg-Calvé-Perthes disease as a child but trained without breaks. Exceptional early specialization and achievement.
inherited_summary: Father Hitoshi was a judo black belt and Japanese national arm wrestling champion who ran a udon shop, then worked in a factory. Father learned boxing alongside his son, became his sparring partner, then his dedicated trainer. Athletic father who became a trainer.
ecosystem_summary: Chukyo High School — a recognized boxing pipeline in Japan. Trained under Hideyasu Ishihara (former OPBF champion). Manager Kiyoshi Hatanaka (former world champion). Elite boxing pipeline + champion mentors.

endowment_summary: Received first motorcycle at 4, competitive racing at 5. Won Catalan junior motocross championship at 7-8. 125cc World Champion at 17. Youngest MotoGP World Champion at 20 as a rookie. Exceptional early start and achievement in motorcycle racing.
inherited_summary: Born to a working-class family in Cervera, Catalonia, Spain. Parents bought a motorized bike but had limited financial means to support competitive racing. Working-class family with no industry connections.
ecosystem_summary: Emilio Alzamora, former 125cc world champion, spotted him at 8 at a local motocross track and became his manager and mentor, providing free equipment from age 9. RACC (Royal Automobile Club of Catalunya) provided top-level machinery. Spanish racing ecosystem. Repsol backing. Once-in-a-generation mentor relationship + free equipment + Spanish racing ecosystem.
